title: Information for Visitors and New Students
text:
This exhibit answers the questions that visitors and future students most often ask about International Burch University (IBU).

The university is located in Ilidža, at Francuske revolucije bb, postal code 71210, Bosnia and Herzegovina. IBU accepts students from all over the world, including Europe, Asia and America.

As for housing, the university has a student dormitory for male students only, and its capacity is limited. University staff give advice to new students who want to live in a rented house or apartment. IBU also cooperates with several private student dormitories nearby and is happy to recommend the one that suits a student best.

Besides tuition, students should also plan for extra costs. International students pay for the residence permit, paperwork and translation of documents. Books and other study materials cost between 100 and 200 euros, depending on the study program and on whether a student buys new or used books.

The university offers various discounts and scholarships. Students who may be eligible include those who won first, second or third place in competitions, successful athletes, students with a certain degree of disability, students without one or both parents, and children of war veterans or of parents who died in the war as members of the Army of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Discounts are also available to students who sign a pre-contract before the admission period begins and to those who achieve a high score on the scholarship exam organized by the university.

The length of studies depends on the faculty. At the Faculty of Education, studies follow the 4+1+3 model (bachelor, master and doctorate), which equals 240+60+180 ECTS credits. At the Faculty of Engineering and Information Technologies, the model is 3+2+3 years, or 180+120+180 ECTS credits. The Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences has both models. The university also offers master and doctoral programs.

All students must show a sufficient level of English. For this purpose there is an English language exam, and valid TOEFL or IELTS certificates are also accepted. The placement exam is held at the university at the end of September, at the start of the academic year. Students who do not pass the exam are advised to attend the English preparatory school. It lasts about eight months and is divided into four levels: A1, A2, B1 and B2.

Transferring to IBU from another university is possible, because the university follows the Bologna criteria. The same documents as for the first enrollment are needed, plus a transcript of grades and a withdrawal letter from the previous university.

The campus has a fully equipped gym with showers, a restaurant, coffee shops, a student pavilion and parking for students and visitors. There are also outdoor basketball and football courts, a large indoor sports hall, a reading room, a library, free Wi-Fi for students and visitors and a large conference hall. The facilities are guarded and are meant only for IBU students and staff.

IBU is an accredited university, and its diploma is recognized in the European Union and in the United States.
